decisions.reason: The accent remains derived from the Hero V geometry; selecting and refining the current Hero V direction changes the referenced geometry but does not alter the candidate's derivation rule or geometric-consistency requirement.
The closing V remains governed by the existing rule that it derives from the Hero V geometry. The source does not independently change that rule or specify a new closing-V requirement.
The source exclusively refines the Hero V's arm relationship and character; it neither resumes nor changes the deferred E and L letterform requirement.
The source discusses geometric character and added visual heaviness, not the deferred champagne material treatment or its role.
Experiencing the Hero V as one complete letter concerns unity between its two arms, not spacing among the letters of the full wordmark; the deferred kerning requirement remains unchanged.
Although the client refers to the freelancer's notes, the source does not change the obligation to include design rationale with review rounds.
The source refines the internal geometry of the opening Hero V and does not change the closing V's smaller, subordinate visual prominence.
